body.name: Actual-filtration characteristic handle
body.construction: Couple the all-pairs extension of original PSRR by common transpositions to a stationary uniform-allocation shadow; before first entry, use exact centering of the antisymmetric Metropolis-kink score against the deterministic population empirical measure to control drift and cross-characteristics uniformly along localized proposal-time paths. Analyze the single terminal crossing directly from its exact transposition increment and the vanishing jump size, without invoking the singular drift expansion at or after \(T_n\).
